details:
This bug doesn’t seem to occur until you’ve already gone to at least 2 worlds, and thus have been in the transition at least twice. (I am counting the home world as well)

*Edit: so further testing reveals that when it triggers is based on how long you’ve been logged in for, not how many worlds you’ve been to. I figured it out after hanging around with a friend in my home world, then attempting to head to a new world.*

Steps to reproduce should be simple, since I can’t avoid the issue myself.

[1] load into Vrchat and set up any OSC of your choice, all my testing was done with a fbt OSC.

[2] head to another world while it’s enabled (this will be normal)

[3] head to another world again or otherwise enter the world transition ‘area’

[4] if the bug did not occur(everything appears normal), then try heading to another world again. I noticed that the bug is somewhat inconsistent, but I have encountered it too many times for me to not make a post.

The screen should now be fully blue, or in some cases, black. The controllers are not visible at all but you can still interact with the buttons ‘go’ and ‘return home’, despite not being able to see the buttons(this will not fix the bug mind you)
title: Black/Blue screen during world transition with OSC tracking enabled
